extraction_scope: Source-reviewed final activity/toxicity evidence from primary XML/PDF Table 3, Figure 4/prose, and methods; prior parser output was corrected for paired μg/mL/μM MIC columns.
source_review_notes: Table 3 contains 5 MIC value columns: S. aureus μg/mL/μM, E. coli μg/mL/μM, and P. aeruginosae μg/mL. The prior 60-row parser result treated μM values as organism columns and is superseded.
LD50 values for MP-RIP and RIP-MP are supported by the cytotoxicity section and Figure 4 caption/methods.
Supplementary PDF contains HPLC/MALDI figures and molecular weight Table S1; it does not add activity, toxicity, or mechanism endpoints beyond identity confirmation.
